summary: Complete E2E frontend testing of iteration 2 (navy/beige buttons, mobile chat double-header fix, densified mobile chat header, and full button coverage on Aujourd'hui, Ma Vision, Mon Refuge). All 7 scenarios from the review request PASS. Backend demo-login verified (200). Only note: heavy 429 Cloudflare rate-limits during the run — had to throttle and retry.
critical_code_review_comments: Layout.jsx (553 lines) still mixes Sidebar/Header/BottomNav/AppShell — worth splitting further.
ChatPanel.jsx > 800 lines; consider extracting NewsConversation, ActionCard, DraftMessage into their own files for maintainability.
Heavy 429 rate-limits on the preview domain during automated runs — throttle documented for future testers.
seed_data_creation: One capture task 'TEST_task_from_playwright' created on / and one task check toggle (side-effect expected by the review).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview: https://refugio-vision.preview.emergentagent.com. Auth: POST /api/auth/demo-login {email:'thomas@zayado.fr'} then localStorage.setItem('cours_auth_token', <token>). Skip modals: mx_welcome_tour_done=1 and mx_premiers_pas_dismissed=1 in localStorage before nav. Cloudflare 429s occur when hammering — wait 60-90s between full runs. Sidebar Vision id is now 'vision' (data-testid side-vision / bottomnav-vision), consistent with review spec.

detailed_scenario_results.1_bugfix_double_header_chat_mobile_390: PASS — inside [data-testid=copilot-mobile-fullscreen]: identity=1 (single hub-product-identity), backBtn=1 (single copilot-back). No stacked 'Copilote' bar. hub-product-subtitle display:none. hub-context-label display:none. hub-product-name renders on single line (height 15.6px, text 'MyExtension Business'). Bouton Retour closes the panel and Aujourd'hui page ([data-testid=capture-input]) is visible again.
detailed_scenario_results.2_boutons_navy_beige: PASS — computed style of .gold-bg = linear-gradient(135deg, rgb(30,52,104) 0%, rgb(11,31,58) 60%, rgb(8,23,52) 100%) with color rgb(241,226,204) (beige). Navy gradient, beige text, readable contrast.
detailed_scenario_results.3_page_aujourdhui: PASS — mode-elan-btn / mode-refuge-btn toggle OK. ouvrir-copilote-btn opens copilot-panel. capture-input + capture-submit creates task, tache-check- toggles status. raccourci-vision navigates to /vision. raccourci-decision + raccourci-idee both open copilote. graphique-actions-cta / graphique-energie-cta not visible (Thomas already has data — expected fallback: charts render instead).
detailed_scenario_results.4_page_ma_vision: PASS — /vision loads with data-testids: page-ma-vision, vision-synthese, vision-raison-etre, vision-long-terme, vision-strategie, vision-jalons, vision-decisions, vision-idees, vision-idees-copilot, vision-atelier, vision-open-atelier. No dead button.
detailed_scenario_results.5_page_mon_refuge: PASS — refuge-energie-slider (set to 70 via input event), 6 refuge-humeur-* buttons selectable, refuge-note-input accepts text, refuge-respiration-toggle starts/stops the cycle, refuge-foi-toggle shows refuge-verset (visible=true after toggle), refuge-copilote-btn opens copilot-panel. Check-in submit not fired to avoid side-effects on shared Thomas seed.
detailed_scenario_results.6_responsive_390: PASS — scrollWidth=clientWidth=390 on /, /vision, /refuge (no horizontal overflow). bottom-nav has exactly 4 entries: bottomnav-aujourdhui, bottomnav-vision, bottomnav-copilote, bottomnav-refuge.
detailed_scenario_results.7_desktop_copilot_fab: PASS — [data-testid=copilot-fab] visible on desktop, click opens copilot-right-drawer + copilot-panel.
